descriptions.default: Two mourners with arms raised: the lament at the head of the procession.
Six women walk with their hands to their chests.
An empty canopy frame carried in the procession.
A man hauls the canopy frame on its sledge by a rope.
Anubis as a jackal on a chest, dragged on a sledge. You will meet him again at the judgment.
A man hauls Anubis's chest on its sledge by a rope.
A processional boat with the funerary bier.
A priest walks before the bier with a censer, offering incense.
A man hauls the sledge rope.
descriptions.stalled: A man hauls the sledge rope. The bier is stalled. Ask the ox-driver how to haul it.

descriptions.default: A man with a stick drives the ox that pulls the sledge.
The ox pulls the sledge with the mummy's bier.
The sacred apis bull, crowned with plumes, walking along the procession.
descriptions.unresolved: A bull walking towards the sacrifice.

descriptions.default: A young calf leaps toward the plumed ox.
descriptions.unsettled: The young calf shakes at the sight of the sacrifice.

descriptions.default: A man walks under a portable canopy.
A man carries two vessels on a shoulder yoke.
Two women walk in the procession.
A bull is thrown down and butchered.
descriptions.unresolved: The Apis bull should never be slaughtered. (Not even Cambyses did it, despite what Herodotus claimed.)

descriptions.default: The lector priest reads from a scroll.
A great heaped table of bread, meat, fowl and fruit, between pairs of trees.
descriptions.collapsed: The offering table has collapsed. Only a few loaves, a small head and a pomegranate still stand; everything else lies on the floor between the bouquets. Speak with the lector priest beside it.

descriptions.default: A man holds a water jar over the offering table for purification.
Two obelisks stand on their bases.
A small stand with two rods, a hooked adze, and a foreleg laid on it.
He holds incense over the small stand, purifying the sacred implements for the Opening of the Mouth ritual.
A lector priest in a two-feather headdress reads something from a sheet.
A priest raises a round jar and pours purifying water. The wavy line is the stream: it arches over Anubis and the mummy.
A woman kneels with her hands raised, under the stream of water.
Anubis holds the mummy upright on a low base before the tomb.
descriptions.unopened: Anubis holds the mummy upright on a low base before the tomb. The mummy's mouth is not opened yet, and needs the right tool.

descriptions.default: A round-topped stela under the winged sun. Faint on its face: a stand, the sun disc on it, a lotus bending over it.
descriptions.blank: A round-topped stela under the winged sun. Its face is blank.

descriptions.default: The tomb: a chapel with a cornice, crowned by a small pyramid.
Ra sits on his throne with the sun disc on his head and a staff in his hand.
Beginning of the chapters about the going forth by day and the carrying of the shades into the Netherworld.
To be said on the day of burial in order to go in after coming forth.
Adoration to Ra when he rises above the eastern horizon in Heaven.
Adoration to the sun when it sets in the Land of Life.
